findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There were drink particle residues observed dumped in the hand sink opposite of the ice machine. The PIC was made aware. The hand sink was cleaned. Ensure that all hand sinks within the facility are use for handwashing only and nothing else including dumping drinks and other items at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There was no hand soap in the dispensers at the hand sink opposite of the ice machine and the hand sink on the right side of the standing freezer use to store the harsh browns. The PIC was made aware. Hand soap was provided for the dispensers mentioned. Ensure that every hand sinks within the facility is supplied with the appropriate material.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The ice dispensers on the two soda machines were observed to have a pink and black mold buildup. PIC was made aware. The two dispensers were cleaned and sanitized. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the ice dispenser on the soda machines are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized routinely.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.
